# MixedSignalGraph

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Analog traces and digital lines on a shared time axis (CHART-103). Same traits and messages as DigitalWaveformGraph, plus the analog part.

![MixedSignalGraph, light theme](../img/widgets/mixed-signal-graph-light.png#only-light){ width="428" }
![MixedSignalGraph, dark theme](../img/widgets/mixed-signal-graph-dark.png#only-dark){ width="428" }

**Graphs, time** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.MixedSignalGraph) ·
schema [`mixedgraph.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.MixedSignalGraph(
    label="MixedSignalGraph",
    lines=["TRIG"],
    dt=0.01,
    traces=[{"name": "analog"}],
    analog_fraction=0.6,
    annotations=[{"x": 0.5, "y": 0.9, "text": "threshold", "color": ""}],
    x_unit="s",
    size=(420, 200),
)
```

The data of the picture (samples, history or drawing) is sent with the widget's methods,
not as traits: see the [widget catalog](../widgets.md).

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | array | `[520,320]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | object | `{}` | host | Size of the data {n_samples, n_lines}, written by the host with each data message. |
| `lines` | array of string | `[]` | host | Line names; a missing name is shown as D<k>. Python names the lines D0, D1, ... when their number changes. |
| `buses` | array of object | `[]` | host | Groups of lines {name, lines} shown as one hexadecimal value (first listed line = MSB). Python rejects buses naming a missing line; the front end ignores such lines. |
| `dt` | number | `1` | host | Sample interval in x-axis units; 0 is shown as 1. |
| `x0` | number | `0` | host | x-axis position of the first sample. |
| `show_lines_in_bus` | boolean | `true` | host | Also draw the lines of each bus under it. |
| `traces` | array of object | `[]` | host | Optional style of each analog trace {name, color, width, visible}. |
| `y_min` | number or null | `null` | host | Analog y range; null (either limit): scaled to the data. |
| `y_max` | number or null | `null` | host | A number, or null when not set. |
| `analog_fraction` | number | `0.55` | host | Share of the height given to the analog traces. |
